tag: 小型企業貸款申請補件與擔保品要求信

level.why: 長句中包含讓步子句、分詞構句與被動語態，並需整合推薦信、擔保品、對帳單等多項要求；字彙如 collateral、signify 較抽象，干擾項皆取自文中資訊。

passage:
Subject: Your Small Business Loan Application

Dear Ms. Hartwell,

Thank you for submitting your application for a 150,000-dollar expansion loan for Hartwell Woodworks. Although your sales records are impressive, and your decision to hire an apprentice from the local trade school suggests a commitment to long-term growth, the credit committee has asked for several additional items before it can proceed.

First, please provide a reference letter from a senior executive at one of your major clients, preferably one that has purchased from you for more than three years. Second, because you filed for bankruptcy in 2014 before reorganizing the business, the committee requires collateral valued at no less than 60 percent of the loan amount. Finally, we need your updated monthly statements, which should lay out all recurring expenses, including equipment leases.

I understand these requirements may seem demanding, but I would like to reassure you that they are standard for loans of this size. Please note that receipt of the documents does not signify approval; it merely allows the committee to complete its review. Because the bank's funds are plentiful this quarter, a decision can be reached within ten business days of receiving everything.

Sincerely,
Daniel Cho
Senior Loan Officer, Riverside Commercial Bank
zh:
主旨：您的小型企業貸款申請

哈特威爾女士您好：

感謝您為哈特威爾木工坊提出 150,000 美元擴廠貸款的申請。雖然您的銷售紀錄令人印象深刻，而且您決定從當地技職學校聘請一名學徒，顯示您對長期成長的承諾，但授信委員會仍要求在進入下一階段之前，先補充數項資料。

首先，請提供一封由貴公司主要客戶之一的資深主管出具的推薦信，最好是已向您採購超過三年的客戶。其次，由於您在 2014 年曾申請破產，之後才重整事業，委員會要求提供價值不低於貸款金額 60% 的擔保品。最後，我們需要您最新的月結對帳單，並請詳列所有經常性支出，包括設備租賃費用。

我理解這些要求可能顯得嚴苛，但我想向您保證，對於這種規模的貸款而言，這些都是標準作業。請注意，收到文件並不代表核准，只是讓委員會得以完成審查。由於本行本季資金充裕，在收齊所有資料後十個工作天內即可做出決定。

誠摯地，
丹尼爾．周
河畔商業銀行資深貸款專員

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the letter?
opts: To announce that a loan has been approved
To explain what the bank needs before it can decide on a loan
To ask the applicant to close her business account
To offer a lower interest rate on an existing loan
why: 錯誤：信中並未核准貸款，反而說收到文件也不代表核准。
正解：信中說明委員會在審查前需要補充的文件與擔保品。
錯誤：信中沒有要求關閉帳戶。
錯誤：信中未提到利率或既有貸款。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT requested from Ms. Hartwell?
opts: A reference letter from a client's executive
Collateral worth at least 60 percent of the loan
A detailed business plan for the expansion
why: 錯誤：信中第一項要求即為客戶資深主管的推薦信。
錯誤：第二項要求為價值不低於貸款 60% 的擔保品。
正解：信中從未要求擴廠事業計畫書，故為未被要求的項目。
錯誤：第三項要求即為列出經常性支出的月結對帳單。

questions.q: What can be inferred from the letter about the bank's decision?
opts: It may still be denied even after all documents are received
It will be announced within three years
It depends on the apprentice's performance
It has already been made by the credit committee
why: 正解：信中說收到文件並不代表核准，可推知仍可能被拒絕。
錯誤：三年是客戶採購的年限，並非決定時程。
錯誤：學徒只是顯示成長承諾，並非決定依據。
錯誤：委員會仍在等待補件，尚未做出決定。

questions.q: The bank will not release the funds ______ all required documents have been verified.
why: 錯誤：while 表示同時，語意不通。
錯誤：despite 後接名詞，且語意相反。
錯誤：throughout 為介系詞，不能連接子句。
正解：not ... until 表示「直到…才」，符合語意。

questions.q: The bank's lending policy is ______ reviewed every year by an independent committee.
why: 錯誤：形容詞不能修飾被動動詞 reviewed。
正解：此處需副詞 thoroughly 修飾過去分詞 reviewed。
錯誤：名詞不能修飾動詞。
錯誤：比較級形容詞同樣不能修飾動詞。

questions.q: Interest charges will be applied ______ the outstanding balance at the end of each month.
why: 錯誤：by 表示以…方式或截止時間，搭配不當。
錯誤：at 常接時間點或價格，不用於計息對象。
正解：be applied on the balance 表示對餘額計息。
錯誤：for 表示目的或期間，搭配不當。
